title: Techify Canva Pro Upgrade Landing Page (Go-live + Phone & UPI)

requirements.text: Recreate the provided single-page Techify landing page as the app’s main React (TypeScript) page, matching the layout/sections and Tailwind styling from the supplied HTML (navbar, hero/pricing card with CTA, trusted-by band, features grid, FAQ section, mobile sticky CTA, footer).

quotes:
make this live and add phone number 9622655116 
upi id 9622655116@ybl

<!DOCTYPE html> ...

acceptanceCriteria: Visually matches the provided HTML page structure and styling using Tailwind classes in React components.
All sections from the provided HTML exist on the rendered page and are responsive (mobile + desktop).
No external Tailwind CDN script is required at runtime; styling is handled via the project’s Tailwind build setup.

requirements.text: Update contact details across the page to use phone number 9622655116, including: (1) the WhatsApp Support link (wa.me) to message the correct number, and (2) at least one visible place on the page (e.g., footer and/or a contact/support area) showing the phone number with a clickable tel: link.
acceptanceCriteria: WhatsApp Support button/link points to a wa.me URL using phone number 9622655116 (with appropriate country code formatting).
Phone number 9622655116 is visibly displayed on the page and clicking it initiates a call via a tel: link on supported devices.
No remaining placeholder phone numbers (e.g., 919999999999) appear in the UI or links.

requirements.text: Add UPI ID 9622655116@ybl to the page and connect both CTA buttons (desktop “GET INSTANT ACCESS” and mobile bottom CTA) to a working UPI payment action by replacing the placeholder href "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" with a UPI payment deep link derived from the provided UPI ID.
acceptanceCriteria: UPI ID 9622655116@ybl is visible on the page (e.g., near pricing/CTA) as selectable/copyable text.
Both CTAs no longer use "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" and instead open a UPI payment deep link that includes pa=9622655116@ybl.
No occurrences of the placeholder "YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK" remain in the codebase/UI.

requirements.text: Make the app production-ready for go-live by ensuring it builds successfully and is configured as a single-page public landing page (no login required), including a short, English deployment note in the project documentation describing how to deploy to the Internet Computer with the project’s standard workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: A production build completes without errors.
The deployed app loads directly to the landing page as the default route.
Project includes brief English instructions describing the steps to deploy/go-live on the Internet Computer (using the project’s standard tooling).

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, modern visual theme consistent with the provided design (tech/marketing aesthetic) and enforce consistent typography, spacing, and button styles across the page while keeping all user-facing text in English.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: Typography and spacing are consistent across all sections (headings, body text, cards, and CTAs).
Buttons/links have consistent hover/focus styles and accessible contrast.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead if needed).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Integrating external payment gateways (e.g., Stripe) beyond linking to the provided UPI ID.
Building an admin panel, order management, email delivery automation, or real-time chat/support.
